cards.title: Validity Criteria for MIC Assays
cards.claim: MIC results are only valid if: (1) positive growth control shows obvious button or definite turbidity, (2) pure culture is confirmed via subculture, and (3) inoculum is correct at 5 x 10^5 CFU/mL.
conditions: Inoculum verification: 10 µL from growth control diluted in 10 mL saline; 100 µL spread on agar should yield 20-80 colonies.
Purity check: Subculture from growth-control well immediately after inoculation.
limitations: Failure to meet these criteria invalidates the MIC result for that isolate/agent combination.
cards.downstream_use: Quality control filter for data cleaning; invalid assays must be excluded from PK/PD analysis.

note: Method/reference scope retained; source identity is available in original evidence.
